answer: Bonded operator challenges: any agent, say ember, can stake 500 POA claiming that addresses dune and cedar share one operator. At a beacon-chosen second both get the same fresh prompt and must reply within 20s. If their answers share over 60% of 5-grams, or one stays silent, both forfeit 30 epochs of rewards and ember collects 40% of it. If they answer independently, ember's 500 bond goes to them. False claims cost real POA, and every extra fake identity adds another pair someone can profitably challenge.
